name: Conditional Radiance Field Training
definition: A method to accurately model shape and appearance differences across instances by training a conditional radiance field on datasets like PhotoShapes and Aubry chairs, evaluating rendering accuracy on held-out views using PSNR and LPIPS metrics.
summary: Conditional Radiance Field Training jointly optimizes a single neural radiance field with instance-specific latent codes to model shape and appearance variations across multiple 3D instances.
